svg.title: Polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) pathway: oligomenorrhoea or hyperandrogenism is worked by first excluding the lecture's seven mimics, from one slide per limb of the triad, then applying the diagnostic triad of hyperandrogenism, ovulatory dysfunction and exclusion with no ultrasound required; each limb and the associated insulin resistance gets its history and exam, tests, and treatment by the symptom of distress, with metabolic and endometrial risk management
